summary.text: Sue Mulvey is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 50 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Michele Brooks in a rematch of the 2018 race.
She is a registered nurse who has worked as a school nurse.

paragraphs.text: Sue Mulvey graduated from Conneaut Lake High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Slippery Rock University in 2009 and a graduate degree from the American College of Education in 2017, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in Conneaut Lake and has been a school nurse in the Crawford Central School District for 15 years.
She said she founded a nonprofit organization that provided weekend meals to more than 500 children during the school year.
Mulvey ran for the same seat in 2018 and lost to Brooks, 65.6 percent to 34.4 percent.
She advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her first listed campaign message in the survey was affordability, including putting working families and seniors first.
